name: add-to-agent-context
description: Copies the active file's full path with the selected line range, or adds it straight into a coding agent's context.

commands.title: Add Path With Line Selection to Agent

addToAgentContext.agents.description: Agents that can receive the path with line selection, keyed by agent id
addToAgentContext.agents.markdownDescription: Agent extensions that `addToAgentContext.sendToAgent` and `addToAgentContext.pickAction` can target, keyed by a stable agent id (used to remember the last agent you sent to). Your entries are merged with the defaults: add a new key to add an agent, set only the fields you want to change on an existing one, or set it to `null` to remove it. Each entry needs a `command`, and is shown by its `label`, or its id when no label is set; an agent whose extension is missing, or whose command is no longer registered, is reported as unavailable instead of silently doing nothing. Bind the commands yourself in `keybindings.json` (see the README).

label.description: Name shown in the destination picker; defaults to the agent id

extensionId.description: Publisher-qualified extension id, checked to tell 'not installed' from 'command renamed'

command.description: Command that adds the current editor selection to the agent's context

fileCommand.description: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context, called with its URI
fileCommand.markdownDescription: Command that adds a file or folder to the agent's context. Called once per item selected in the explorer, with that item's URI as the only argument. Agents without it are not offered by `addToAgentContext.pickFileAction`.
